title: Line sketch: Kintsugi Broken Woman Portrait
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized female bust with closed eyes and lips, her form shattered like porcelain and mended with glowing veins in the Japanese kintsugi tradition. The figure is set against a solid dusty background, creating a striking contrast between fragility and repair (derived from painting #740).
